MAR.note: Document covers VAT on ads, nothing on an authentication service.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No ID enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who runs the ID system.
Tax identifier is mentioned but no register keyed on the national ID number is stated.
Nothing on the national ID system.

facts.fact: The Direction generale des impots launched in May 2026 the electronic platform 'Taxation on Digital Services' for non-resident foreign providers to register, declare their Moroccan turnover and pay VAT, under decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025.
